```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Background

Quick comparison of selected analytes measured during SuRGE and the two most recent NLA campaigns (NLA17 and NLA22).

## Data

Required data are created via the targets pipeline. Load data here.

```{r data}
tar_load(dat_raw)
```


## Extraction based chlorophyll a
We are missing extraction-based chlorophyll a measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes (mostly 2016 lakes). `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(chla_lab_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_chla) | !is.na(nla22_chla))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have chla estimates from 2017 and/or 2022 NLA. 

As expected, the concurrence among SuRGE and NLA observations is not great:
```{r chla_plot, echo=FALSE}

{dat_raw %>%
  select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
         chla_lab_shallow, nla17_chla, nla22_chla) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(nla17_chla, nla22_chla),
    names_to = "nla_year",
    values_to = "nla_chla"
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_chla), !is.na(chla_lab_shallow)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_chla, chla_lab_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", chla_lab_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_chla, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id),
      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    ggtitle("Extraction Based Chlorophyll a") +
    xlab("NLA chla") +
    ylab("SuRGE chla")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")



```


## SO4
Sulfate wasn't measured until 2021 and we are missing data for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(so4_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_sulfate) | !is.na(nla22_sulfate))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` of these lakes have sulfate estimates from 2017 and/or 2022 NLA. Comparison of SuRGE and NLA sulfate measurements is actually pretty good. Interestingly, most of the outliers in the plot below are in New Mexico South Dakota. I double checked the NLA and SuRGE data for these sites and don't see any issues. The New Mexico data shown are the mean of visits 1 and 2, which had very similar results. NLA sampled NLA22_NM-10013 in 2017 and 2022 with very similar results (data shown, 243 vs 83). 
```{r so4_plot, echo=FALSE}
{dat_raw %>%
  select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
         so4_shallow, nla17_sulfate, nla22_sulfate) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(nla17_sulfate, nla22_sulfate),
    names_to = "nla_year",
    values_to = "nla_so4"
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_so4), !is.na(so4_shallow)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_so4, so4_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_so4, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id),
      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Sulfate") +
    xlab("NLA SO4") +
    ylab("SuRGE SO4")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```



## NO2_3
We are missing NO2_3 (combined NO2 + NO3) measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(no2_3_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains NO2_3 observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(no2_3_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_nitrate_nitrite_n) | !is.na(nla22_nitrate_nitrite_n))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {"none"} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(no2_3_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_nitrate_nitrite_n) | !is.na(nla22_nitrate_nitrite_n))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes.`

```{r no2_3_plot, echo=FALSE}
{dat_raw %>%
    select(lake_id, nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id,
           no2_3_shallow, 
           nla17_nitrate_n, 
           nla22_nitrate_n) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(nla17_nitrate_n = nla17_nitrate_n * 1000,
           nla22_nitrate_n = nla22_nitrate_n * 1000) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_nitrate_n, nla22_nitrate_n),
      names_to = "nla_year",
      values_to = "nla_no2_3"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(nla_no2_3),
      !is.na(no2_3_shallow)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_no2_3, no2_3_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", no2_3_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_no2_3, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id),
      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggtitle("Nitrate") +
    xlab("NLA NO3") +
    ylab("SuRGE NO2_3")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```

## TN
We are missing TN measurements for `r dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow)) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()` SuRGE lakes. NLA contains TN observations for `r if(dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_ntl) | !is.na(nla22_ntl))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow() == 0) {print("none")} else {dat_raw %>% filter(is.na(tn_shallow) & (!is.na(nla17_ntl) | !is.na(nla22_ntl))) %>% distinct(lake_id) %>% nrow()}` of these lakes.
```{r tn_plot, echo=FALSE}
{dat_raw %>%

           tn_shallow, 
           nla17_ntl, 
           nla22_ntl) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
        mutate(nla17_ntl = nla17_ntl * 1000,
           nla22_ntl = nla22_ntl * 1000) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_ntl, nla22_ntl),
      names_to = "nla_year",
      values_to = "nla_ntl"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(nla_ntl),
      !is.na(tn_shallow)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(nla17_site_id, nla22_site_id),
      names_to = "nla_parameter",
      values_to = "nla_site_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nla_site_id)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla_ntl, tn_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", tn_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA:", nla_ntl, "<br>",
                   "nla_site_id:", nla_site_id, "<br>",

      color = nla_year
    )
    ) +

    ggtitle("Total Nitrogen") +
    xlab("NLA TN") +
    ylab("SuRGE TN") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30000, 1000))} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")


```

## Specific Conductivity
